subject: Cloud Catalog Intake: CloudNova quick intro & demo coordination
messages:
From: Sofia Mendez <sofia.m@cloudnova.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cloud Catalog listing inquiry — quick intro + demo

Hi Ro han,

I found Redwood on the cloud catalog and completed the quick sign-up. I was able to run a small proof-of-concept on a dev instance and would like a short walkthrough of the platform and how Dedicated vs Hosted could map to our compliance needs.

I selected an available demo slot on your calendar (Tue 21 Sep, 3:00 PM PT) but wanted to loop you in directly — my manager will also join. Are you able to confirm and send any pre-demo materials?

Attendees: Sofia Mendez (Engineering Manager) and Carlos Ruiz (CloudOps)
Company: CloudNova

Thanks,
Sofia
--

Engineering Manager | CloudNova
sofia.m@cloudnova.com

From: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
To: Sofia Mendez <sofia.m@cloudnova.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-18T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Catalog listing inquiry — quick intro + demo

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I see the slot you grabbed (Tue 21 Sep, 3:00 PM PT) — that works for us. I've cc'd Dylan from SDR to coordinate calendar logistics and send a short agenda.

High-level 20-30 minute agenda I propose:
- 5 mins: intros and goals
- 10-15 mins: live walkthrough (hosted + dedicated flows)
- 5-10 mins: next steps / procurement questions

If you have compliance questions up front (SOC 2/FIPS/KMS), let me know and we'll make sure an engineer is available. I can also share a short pre-demo checklist.

On attachments: I will drop our one-page intro deck and a checklist once the time is confirmed.

Best,
Ro han Mehta

rohan.mehta@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Quick asks so we make the session valuable:
- Confirm Carlos Ruiz will join and whether he needs an invite to the calendar event (I can add).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Primary asks for the session: private deployment options (VPC / on-prem), KMS integrations, and typical unit economics for concurrent throughput.

Sofia
